links.outcome: LLM guideline-based ERCP triage accuracy and under-triage errors on synthetic vignettes
links.effect: Accuracy 96.0% GPT-5.5, 90.0% Gemini 3.0 Pro, 84.0% Claude 4 Opus; Claude produced 9 under-triage errors and 163.8 simulated delay hours per 100 vignettes (P = .007).
links.quote: Claude 4 Opus produced the most under-triage errors (n = 9) and the largest simulated delay burden (163.8 hours per 100 vignettes; Kruskal-Wallis P = .007).

screen.reason: The study tests several LLMs against clinical vignettes for ERCP triage, evaluating diagnostic accuracy and simulated clinical consequences/delays, but it does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
